classification.difficultyReason: Coordinate upper and lower straight-angle sums with opposite angles to recover both unknowns.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 5, beneath the stem at left
spec.description: Six plain-ended arms meet at a solid vertex. Six angle arcs of differing radii carry bold labels 30°, 110°, r°, f°, 75°, 75° in source order. All sectors remain unfilled.
spec.mathematics: Left and right horizontal arms are collinear. Upper-left and lower-right arms are collinear. The upper sectors total 180 degrees, and the lower sectors total 180 degrees. Both 75-degree givens are retained.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens and the unknown labels r° and f° are visible; completed values are excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}r&=180^\circ-30^\circ-110^\circ\\r&=40^\circ\\f&=180^\circ-75^\circ-75^\circ\\f&=30^\circ\end{align*}$$
